notes.trinkets: Frost Death Knight favours a combination of one active trinket and one passive trinket. For active trinkets, Voracious Heart of Ula'tek is by far our best option with great synergy with our 1.5 minute Cooldowns. It also comes at a higher ilvl due to dropping from the final boss.
